scope: BGS system source, tests and observer audit only

changes.problem: Machine handoff embedded inside authoritative human documents
changes.repair: External .beegame/design-handoffs/<document stem>.json; prose retains decisions and readable tables. Shared parser and all author/review/acceptance consumers use sidecars. Existing format fields retained; documentVersion added.

changes.problem: Revisions did not necessarily increase document versions
changes.repair: Exactly one numeric document version header; matching sidecar documentVersion. Host enforces increases for changed prose, handoff or cited calculation files, including scheduled technical completion and explicitly supplied owner revisions. Unchanged documents keep their versions.

changes.problem: Source identities could omit external machine handoff
changes.repair: Design snapshots bind prose, sidecars and linked calculation evidence. Formal Content authority includes sidecars; runtime requirement records bind both documentSha256 and handoffSha256. Neither the owned prose nor its sidecar counts as result evidence.

changes.problem: Revise changed prose but native permissions denied the retained numerical model
changes.repair: Trusted task metadata lists exact existing cited docs/calc files and affected sidecars. Revise permits these exact Write/Edit targets and numerical helper model/output operands, still subject to original native permissions. Inspect/Verify remain read-only. No generic shell, extra scripts, --verify, directory grants, new linked calculation files or symlinks.

changes.problem: Verifier's accurate remaining-impact description was rejected as finding redefinition
changes.repair: Independent checks may update impact text only. Identity, severity, owner, scope, source pointers, deadline and closure condition remain unchanged; Revise preserves findings and cannot self-close. Remaining blockers stop release.

changes.problem: Scope/interface friction and repeated unchanged checks enlarge model histories
changes.repair: Exact source/sidecar/calculation locations supplied; numerical instructions only for relevant scope. Existing host checks reused while inputs unchanged and rerun after grouped edits. No additional semantic loop or new framework.

coverage: explicit owner and scheduled technical version enforcement
exact native file and helper-command boundaries including symlinks/workspace aliases
original native permissions still adjudicate execution
stale source/sidecar acceptance and design-as-result evidence rejected
simulated native Revise recomputes retained appendix, binds saved v1.1 sources and reaches read-only Verify
remaining-impact update does not downgrade or release a blocker

typecheck.root: not passed: existing sceneContentAdapter module/type errors and pre-existing test type errors remain; final rerun reports no type error in the new repair paths

verification.tokenOrCreditImprovement: not measured in a new paid run

compatibility.existingInlineHandoff: Rejected with exact external destination; authorized native writer must migrate and synchronize versions.
compatibility.existingPaidProducts: Not changed, restored, deleted or replaced. Prior paid receipts and run evidence preserved.
compatibility.unchangedDesignPolicy: No all-document rewrite, decision registry or additional review stage.

limits: Structural checks and source hashes do not prove semantic consistency or truthful runtime observation.
The previously observed Audio contradiction and true model-review efficacy have not been demonstrated fixed by this offline repair.
Overall high-context token accumulation remains unproven resolved; removing execution friction does not establish a measured reduction.
Numerical helper is not a project-code sandbox; execution remains subject to native tool permissions, never inside the BGS server.
New/missing numerical artifacts require an explicit owner/authorized creation step; bounded Revise grants only existing cited retained files.
